64: // Arbiter module
65: class Arbiter extends Module {
66:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
67:     val active = Input(Bool())
68:     val sel = Output(Selection())
69:   })
70:   
71:   val state = RegInit(Selection.A)
72:   
73:   io.sel := Mux(io.active, state, Selection.X)
74:   
75:   when(io.active) {
76:     switch(state) {
77:       is(Selection.A) {
78:         state := Selection.B
79:       }
80:       is(Selection.B) {
81:         state := Selection.C
82:       }
83:       is(Selection.C) {
84:         state := Selection.A
85:       }
86:     }
87:   }
88: }

90: // Client module
91: class Client extends Module {
92:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
93:     val ack = Input(Bool())
94:     val req = Output(Bool())
95:   })
96:   
97:   val state = RegInit(ClientState.NO_REQ)
98:   val reqReg = RegInit(false.B)
99:   
100:   // Simple pseudo-random choice using LFSR
101:   val lfsr = RegInit(1.U(8.W))
102:   val randChoice = lfsr(0)
103:   lfsr := Cat(lfsr(6), lfsr(5), lfsr(4), lfsr(3), lfsr(2), lfsr(1), lfsr(0), lfsr(6) ^ lfsr(5))
104:   
105:   io.req := reqReg
106:   
107:   switch(state) {
108:     is(ClientState.NO_REQ) {
109:       when(randChoice) {
110:         reqReg := true.B
111:         state := ClientState.REQ
112:       }
113:     }
114:     is(ClientState.REQ) {
115:       when(io.ack) {
116:         state := ClientState.HAVE_TOKEN
117:       }
118:     }
119:     is(ClientState.HAVE_TOKEN) {
120:       when(randChoice) {
121:         reqReg := false.B
122:         state := ClientState.NO_REQ
123:       }
124:     }
125:   }
126: }
